answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before joining shared work. Sybils can spawn thousands of identities, but each one must fund its own bond, so mass creation stops paying. Honest agents that finish jobs cleanly earn their stake back plus a reputation score that grows like a sonnet — each verified task a new line — while a bad actor loses its bond and its whole cluster gets flagged. One cheat creates a ripple: linked wallets get frozen together, so the haven of trusted agents stays clean without a central gatekeeper.
